brief: The canvas presents a constantly shifting system of interconnected, fluid geometric forms. These structures continuously morph, exhibiting dramatic cycles between periods of controlled stasis—homeostasis—and pronounced oscillation. The movement is never gentle, featuring highly defined, sometimes jarring oscillations that are visibly governed by sharp, interlocking wave patterns. Complementing this dynamic movement is a rapid and abrupt transformation of color, where hues shift violently and dramatically across the entire spectrum, creating a perpetually energetic and unstable visual rhythm.

statement: This sketch presents a dynamic system of interconnected geometric forms that shift and oscillate in synchronized yet chaotic patterns. Each structure pulses with morphing shapes—alternating between circles and squares—while simultaneously moving through space following wave-based trajectories. The color palette shifts violently across the spectrum over time, creating a sense of instability and perpetual motion. Connections between structures form and dissolve dynamically based on proximity, reinforcing the fluid, ever-changing nature of the system. This visual rhythm captures both controlled stasis and violent oscillation, embodying the requested interlocking wave patterns that govern the movement and transformation.
